hero.headline: Campus news, classes and help in one app.
hero.subline: Check today's timetable, read official notices, join a club, or send an alert to campus security. Sign in with your university email.
hero.pilotNotice: Until the university adopts this app, also call campus security in an emergency.

problem.heading: The problem
problem.paragraph: Right now, campus information is spread across WhatsApp groups, notice boards, email and word of mouth. A class moves to another room and you find out when you get there. An urgent notice goes out and half the batch misses it.
problem.subline: Staff answer the same question in five places.

safety.title: Safety
safety.text: Send an alert in under 10 seconds. Choose what happened, share your location, confirm. You see who has picked it up and what they have done.

academics.title: Academics
academics.text: Today's classes, room changes, deadlines and exam seats. When a class moves, you get told straight away.

notices.title: Notices
notices.text: One official list for the whole university. Urgent notices stay at the top. You only see notices meant for your course, year and department.

events.title: Events
events.text: See what is on this month. Register, cancel, or add it to your calendar. If an event is full, you join the waiting list.

clubs.title: Clubs
clubs.text: Literature, sports, science, art, NSS, NCC, yoga and more. Join in one tap. Club leads post updates and events on their own page.

messages.title: Messages
messages.text: Write to your teachers, advisors and club leads. Block or report anyone who bothers you.

safetyDetail.step1: 1. You pick what happened and share where you are.
safetyDetail.step2: 2. Security and your hostel or department contact get the alert.
safetyDetail.step3: 3. An officer confirms and you see their name.
safetyDetail.guarantee: The app shows "received" only after security has actually received it.

students.text: Open the app to see today's classes, new notices and events. Send an alert if you need help.

faculty.text: Post a class change once. Students see it and confirm they have read it.

admin.text: Send a notice to one department or the whole campus. See who has read it. Manage events, clubs and safety alerts from one place.

security.text: See the alerts assigned to you, with the location. Confirm, add notes, and close them in the app.
